log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

log_dir.description: Directory where log files are written.

bind_host.description: IP address the mDNS service listens on (typically loopback for internal use).

bind_port.description: UDP port the mDNS service listens on. Standard mDNS port is 5355.

workers.description: Number of worker processes to spawn for handling requests.

max_request_body_size.description: Maximum allowed size (in bytes) of an incoming request body.

rpc_backend.description: RPC transport backend (only 'rabbit' is supported in current releases).

rabbit_host.description: Hostname or IP of the RabbitMQ message broker.

rabbit_port.description: Port of the RabbitMQ message broker.

rabbit_password.description: Password for RabbitMQ authentication (use secrets management in production).

rabbit_virtual_host.description: Virtual host in RabbitMQ for designate messages.

storage_driver.description: Storage backend driver. Only 'sql' is used for mDNS.

sql_connection.description: Database connection URL (e.g., MySQL or PostgreSQL).

mdns_enabled.description: Whether the mDNS service should be active.

max_responses.description: Maximum number of DNS resource records to return per query (per RFC limits).

negative_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for negative (error) DNS responses.

edns_enabled.description: Enable EDNS (Extension Mechanisms for DNS) support.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to SSL certificate file (optional, for TLS support).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key file (optional, for TLS support).
